GF14: fourteen bits

You will learn

How 14 bits split into 1 + 5 + 8, a ratio 0.007 from 1 / phi.

GF14 has 14 bits: 1 sign, 5 exponent, 8 mantissa, bias 15. Its ratio E / M is 0.625, only 0.007 from 1 / phi, because 5 and 8 are neighbouring Fibonacci numbers, and the ratio of neighbours approaches 1 / phi.

Try it

Find PHI_DIST in gf14.t27 and compare it with GF10. Then name the next pair of Fibonacci numbers after 5 and 8.
